lighting.title: Lighting
lighting.tip1: Shoot in well-lit area or outdoors in daylight
lighting.tip2: Avoid shooting against the sun — keep it behind the camera
lighting.tip3: Natural lighting is better than artificial flash

angle.title: Angle & Frame
angle.tip1: Always shoot horizontally (Landscape) for wider frame
angle.tip2: Keep your entire body in the frame
angle.tip3: Keep camera far enough to see all your movements

duration.title: Duration & Content
duration.tip1: Ideal clip is between 30s and 3 mins
duration.tip2: Start with your best moments in the first 10 seconds
duration.tip3: Prefer one skill video over multiple skills in same clip

professional.title: Professional Content
professional.tip1: Add name & position in first second or text overlay
professional.tip2: Clean the pitch or background before shooting
professional.tip3: Record clips of: shots, dribbles, passes

quality.title: Tech & Quality
quality.tip2: Disable notifications to avoid shoot interruption
quality.tip3: Upload on YouTube or upload directly under 200MB
